calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) units, COUNT(*) line_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'),
d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT 'lines', COUNT(*), SUM(quantity), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM d), MIN(quantity), MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM l
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', COUNT(*), SUM(units_sold), SUM(receipts), NULL, MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date), NULL FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'zz', COUNT(*), SUM(quantity), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM l JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE p.category='ZZ Test'

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, cp.sku
LIMIT 3
